name: Misaki Wakana
source:
A housewife living next to the protagonist. Married at a young age, and thus she already has a daughter in her adolescent years. Her husband rarely comes home due to his love for work. She's good at cooking and likes drinking, despite having a low alcohol tolerance. After Shizuka was born, she's having trouble with her lack of a sex life. 

[Translated and edited from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=660665&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
